description.value: Hungry Guys Kitchen is a downtown Vancouver fast food restaurant with two Granville Street locations, serving hand-crafted gourmet burgers, fries, shakes, salads, and build-your-own bowls made from locally sourced, fresh ingredients. Founded by entrepreneur Aldo Velaj, the concept emphasizes allergen-friendly customization and sustainable sourcing. The 988 Granville location has indoor seating and is wheelchair accessible, making it a comfortable urban refuelling stop for cyclists.
